title: 基于道义策略的自主AI系统运行时治理
summary: 提出AgenticRei框架，利用基于Rei的道义策略语言（OWL表示）在运行时约束LLM驱动的自主AI系统，支持许可/禁止、义务生命周期管理、冲突解决和豁免，弥补现有策略引擎（如XACML、Rego）的不足。
summary_en: Proposes AgenticRei, a framework using deontic policies (OWL) for runtime governance of LLM-driven autonomous AI systems, supporting permissions, obligations, dispensations, and conflict resolution, addressing gaps in current policy engines like XACML and Rego.
